##### 1. Is it really 100% anonymous?

Yes, Story Navigation ensures complete anonymity while browsing Instagram. When you view stories or
reels through our platform, your visit is not tracked by Instagram’s system — your profile never
appears in the “viewed by” list, and your activity leaves no trace. The platform doesn’t require you
to log in, connect your Instagram account, or share personal details. You can safely browse any
public profile without fear of exposure, data tracking, or cookies collecting your information.
Every search is encrypted, and your IP address is never logged or linked to any viewed content.

##### 2. Do I need an Instagram account to use it?

No, you do not need an Instagram account at all. Story Navigation was specifically designed for
users who prefer not to log in or even have an account. You can simply type the username or paste
the profile link of the person whose stories you want to view. Our system automatically retrieves
publicly available stories, posts, and highlights — no authentication, login, or registration
needed. This makes the platform ideal for journalists, analysts, marketers, or casual users who want
to stay completely invisible on Instagram.

##### 3. Can I download stories, reels, and photos?

Absolutely. One of the most powerful features of Story Navigation is the ability to **download
Instagram content anonymously**. You can save stories, reels, highlights, and photos directly to
your device with a single click. All downloads are provided in high resolution, maintaining the
original quality of the media. There are no watermarks, no restrictions, and no need for third-party
apps. This function is especially useful for saving memorable moments, collecting inspiration, or
archiving public posts safely and privately.

##### 4. Is the service really free to use?

Yes — 100% free. Story Navigation was created as a privacy-first utility, and it does not charge
users or show intrusive ads. You can search, browse, and download unlimited content without any
hidden costs or subscriptions. We also never request donations, credit card details, or in-app
purchases. The goal is to keep access to anonymous viewing tools simple and transparent for
everyone, whether you’re using it once or every day. Enjoy full functionality with no limitations or
paywalls.

##### 5. Can I view private Instagram profiles?

Unfortunately, no. Story Navigation only provides access to **public Instagram profiles**. Private
accounts are protected by Instagram’s privacy policies and cannot be accessed without approval from
the account owner. However, if a user switches their account to public, you will immediately be able
to view and download their stories and posts again. Our focus is on maintaining ethical and lawful
access to public information while protecting both user privacy and Instagram’s platform integrity.

##### 6. Is Story Navigation safe and secure?

Yes — safety is our top priority. The platform is designed with advanced encryption and zero data
tracking policies. We do not store search queries, viewed profiles, or downloaded content on our
servers. Your session data exists only while you are browsing and is immediately deleted afterward.
Additionally, our servers use HTTPS and SSL encryption to protect every request from third-party
interference. You can use the service with full confidence that your personal information remains
private and secure at all times.

##### 7. Does it work on all devices?

Yes, Story Navigation is fully responsive and works perfectly on any modern device — including
smartphones, tablets, laptops, and desktop computers. Whether you’re on Android, iOS, Windows, or
macOS, the interface automatically adjusts for smooth navigation. You can use it through any web
browser such as Chrome, Safari, Edge, or Firefox — no installation or extensions required.
Everything runs directly online, ensuring the fastest and easiest experience possible.

##### 8. Is my IP address or activity logged?

No, we never track or log any user data. Story Navigation operates on a **no-log policy**, meaning
that your IP address, searches, and browsing actions are not stored, shared, or analyzed. The
platform doesn’t use analytics tools or external trackers that could compromise your privacy. Once
you leave the site, all session data is wiped automatically. You can think of Story Navigation as a
private browser window for Instagram — one that leaves no footprints behind.

##### 9. What types of Instagram content can I view?

You can view and download all **publicly available Instagram content**: stories, highlights, reels,
videos, profile pictures, posts, and even captions. The system automatically organizes media for
convenient browsing — no need to log in or scroll endlessly. You can switch between different types
of content within one user-friendly interface, making exploration quick and seamless. The viewer
updates in real time, so you always get the most recent stories and posts the moment they appear on
Instagram.

##### 10. Are there any limits or restrictions?

No, there are no limits on how many profiles you can search or how often you can use the service.
Story Navigation is built for unlimited access — browse freely, anytime, anywhere. The only
restriction is that we respect Instagram’s terms of use, so access is limited to publicly available
content only. You can explore as many stories, reels, and posts as you like without ever creating an
account or installing software. Our system is designed to remain stable, fast, and private
regardless of how frequently it’s used.

## Frequently Asked Questions

<

##### 1. Is it really 100% anonymous?

Yes, Story Navigation ensures complete anonymity while browsing Instagram. When you view stories or
reels through our platform, your visit is not tracked by Instagram’s system — your profile never
appears in the “viewed by” list, and your activity leaves no trace. The platform doesn’t require you
to log in, connect your Instagram account, or share personal details. You can safely browse any
public profile without fear of exposure, data tracking, or cookies collecting your information.
Every search is encrypted, and your IP address is never logged or linked to any viewed content.

##### 2. Do I need an Instagram account to use it?

No, you do not need an Instagram account at all. Story Navigation was specifically designed for
users who prefer not to log in or even have an account. You can simply type the username or paste
the profile link of the person whose stories you want to view. Our system automatically retrieves
publicly available stories, posts, and highlights — no authentication, login, or registration
needed. This makes the platform ideal for journalists, analysts, marketers, or casual users who want
to stay completely invisible on Instagram.

##### 3. Can I download stories, reels, and photos?

Absolutely. One of the most powerful features of Story Navigation is the ability to **download
Instagram content anonymously**. You can save stories, reels, highlights, and photos directly to
your device with a single click. All downloads are provided in high resolution, maintaining the
original quality of the media. There are no watermarks, no restrictions, and no need for third-party
apps. This function is especially useful for saving memorable moments, collecting inspiration, or
archiving public posts safely and privately.

##### 4. Is the service really free to use?

Yes — 100% free. Story Navigation was created as a privacy-first utility, and it does not charge
users or show intrusive ads. You can search, browse, and download unlimited content without any
hidden costs or subscriptions. We also never request donations, credit card details, or in-app
purchases. The goal is to keep access to anonymous viewing tools simple and transparent for
everyone, whether you’re using it once or every day. Enjoy full functionality with no limitations or
paywalls.

##### 5. Can I view private Instagram profiles?

Unfortunately, no. Story Navigation only provides access to **public Instagram profiles**. Private
accounts are protected by Instagram’s privacy policies and cannot be accessed without approval from
the account owner. However, if a user switches their account to public, you will immediately be able
to view and download their stories and posts again. Our focus is on maintaining ethical and lawful
access to public information while protecting both user privacy and Instagram’s platform integrity.

##### 6. Is Story Navigation safe and secure?

Yes — safety is our top priority. The platform is designed with advanced encryption and zero data
tracking policies. We do not store search queries, viewed profiles, or downloaded content on our
servers. Your session data exists only while you are browsing and is immediately deleted afterward.
Additionally, our servers use HTTPS and SSL encryption to protect every request from third-party
interference. You can use the service with full confidence that your personal information remains
private and secure at all times.

##### 7. Does it work on all devices?

Yes, Story Navigation is fully responsive and works perfectly on any modern device — including
smartphones, tablets, laptops, and desktop computers. Whether you’re on Android, iOS, Windows, or
macOS, the interface automatically adjusts for smooth navigation. You can use it through any web
browser such as Chrome, Safari, Edge, or Firefox — no installation or extensions required.
Everything runs directly online, ensuring the fastest and easiest experience possible.

##### 8. Is my IP address or activity logged?

No, we never track or log any user data. Story Navigation operates on a **no-log policy**, meaning
that your IP address, searches, and browsing actions are not stored, shared, or analyzed. The
platform doesn’t use analytics tools or external trackers that could compromise your privacy. Once
you leave the site, all session data is wiped automatically. You can think of Story Navigation as a
private browser window for Instagram — one that leaves no footprints behind.

##### 9. What types of Instagram content can I view?

You can view and download all **publicly available Instagram content**: stories, highlights, reels,
videos, profile pictures, posts, and even captions. The system automatically organizes media for
convenient browsing — no need to log in or scroll endlessly. You can switch between different types
of content within one user-friendly interface, making exploration quick and seamless. The viewer
updates in real time, so you always get the most recent stories and posts the moment they appear on
Instagram.

##### 10. Are there any limits or restrictions?

No, there are no limits on how many profiles you can search or how often you can use the service.
Story Navigation is built for unlimited access — browse freely, anytime, anywhere. The only
restriction is that we respect Instagram’s terms of use, so access is limited to publicly available
content only. You can explore as many stories, reels, and posts as you like without ever creating an
account or installing software. Our system is designed to remain stable, fast, and private
regardless of how frequently it’s used.

# The First and Only Solution for Multi-Vendor Agentic Network Security

The network is entering the agentic era. As AI drives machine-speed change across enterprise
environments, security teams can no longer rely on manual reviews and point-in-time checks.

Tufin gives teams a trusted, unified way to understand connectivity, prove posture continuously, and
control change across complex multi-vendor networks.

[Request a Demo][142]
[Get a Quote][143]

### Find out why thousands of customers trust Tufin

## The Unified Control Plane for the Agentic Era

As agents initiate, validate, and execute more infrastructure change, decisions that affect network
connectivity happen faster than security teams can review manually. Security teams need more than
visibility. They need a trusted way to understand what is actually reachable, validate policy
intent, and govern change across the enterprise.

Tufin provides that control through a unified control plane built for complex multi-vendor networks.

## One Control Plane. Total Network Control.

Tufin manages fragmented tools with a unified control plane that delivers centralized visibility,
automated change control, and continuous compliance across your entire hybrid network.

[

### Unified Visibility Across Hybrid Environments

Delivers the most accurate network topology across firewalls, routers, SASE, and cloud platforms
like AWS, Azure, and GCP—unifying visibility and control across hybrid environments.

See it in action
][144]
[

### Prevents Misconfigurations and Policy Drift

Continuously monitor firewalls, cloud, SASE, and microsegmentation environments to ensure alignment
and enforcement of security policies, preventing lateral movement paths before attackers can exploit
them.

See it in action
][145]
[

### Simplifies and Optimizes Security Policy Management

Reduces policy complexity by analyzing and cleaning up redundant, risky, and outdated rules, while
automatically enforcing least-privilege access to strengthen your overall security posture.

See it in action
][146]
[

### Maintains Continuous Compliance and Audit Readiness

Reduces audit effort and minimizes regulatory risk by continuously assessing policies against
internal standards and external frameworks such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOX, DORA, and NIST.

See it in action
][147]

## A Control Plane for Your Entire Network Security Ecosystem

Tufin integrates seamlessly with the technologies powering your hybrid network—from firewalls to
cloud, SASE, microsegmentation, and beyond.

### Multi-Vendor Firewalls

Centralized visibility and unified policy enforcement across traditional and hybrid mesh
architectures, including Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, Check Point, Fortinet, and more.

The control plane streamlines management, eliminates configuration silos, and ensures consistent,
least-privilege policies across on-premises and cloud networks—helping security teams operate faster
and reduce risk at scale.

### Cloud Environments

Streamlines and automates security policy workflows across public and private cloud
platforms—including AWS, Azure, and GCP to ensure consistent enforcement, reduce risk, and
streamline operations.

The control plane delivers unified visibility across hybrid networks, automates cloud onboarding and
change workflows, and enforces least-privilege policies to prevent network exposure.

[Learn more][148]

### SASE & Edge Networks

Unifies and orchestrates security policies across edge networks by governing and managing
SASE-driven network policies, ensuring consistent, least-privilege access everywhere your remote
users are located.

The control plane provides visibility and control over Firewall-as-a-Service (FWaaS), Zero Trust
Network Access (ZTNA), and SD-WAN policies—ensuring users and workloads stay securely connected
across the network edge and cloud.

[Learn more][149]

### Network Device Topology

Delivers the most accurate network topology for complete visibility across routers, switches, and
connected devices to improve troubleshooting, planning, and operational efficiency.

The control plane automatically maps every network access path and security policy, giving teams a
continuously updated view of their network infrastructure and eliminating blind spots that may lead
to outages or security gaps.

### Microsegmentation

Centralizes visibility and policy management across microsegmentation technologies to enforce
granular, application-level segmentation at scale. Tufin aligns microsegmentation controls with
existing network security policy to eliminate gaps, reduce complexity, and prevent policy drift.

By unifying microsegmentation with traditional firewall and cloud policy management, the Tufin
Control Plane ensures consistent enforcement across hybrid environments. Organizations can isolate
critical assets, prevent lateral movement, and maintain continuous compliance with automated policy
validation and change governance.

[Learn more][150]

### Zero Trust

Operationalizes Zero Trust by enforcing least-privilege access across the entire network security
stack. Tufin ensures that every connection request is verified, authorized, and continuously
monitored through centralized policy orchestration and automated risk-aware change workflows.

By aligning identity-driven access controls with network and cloud security policy, the Tufin
Control Plane eliminates blind spots and ensures consistent enforcement across hybrid environments.
Security teams gain unified visibility, measurable risk reduction, and continuous compliance without
increasing operational overhead.

[Learn more][151]

# The First and Only Solution for Multi-Vendor Agentic Network Security

The network is entering the agentic era. As AI drives machine-speed change across enterprise
environments, security teams can no longer rely on manual reviews and point-in-time checks.

Tufin gives teams a trusted, unified way to understand connectivity, prove posture continuously, and
control change across complex multi-vendor networks.

[Request a Demo][142]
[Get a Quote][143]

### Find out why thousands of customers trust Tufin

## The Unified Control Plane for the Agentic Era

As agents initiate, validate, and execute more infrastructure change, decisions that affect network
connectivity happen faster than security teams can review manually. Security teams need more than
visibility. They need a trusted way to understand what is actually reachable, validate policy
intent, and govern change across the enterprise.

Tufin provides that control through a unified control plane built for complex multi-vendor networks.

## One Control Plane. Total Network Control.

Tufin manages fragmented tools with a unified control plane that delivers centralized visibility,
automated change control, and continuous compliance across your entire hybrid network.

[

### Unified Visibility Across Hybrid Environments

Delivers the most accurate network topology across firewalls, routers, SASE, and cloud platforms
like AWS, Azure, and GCP—unifying visibility and control across hybrid environments.

See it in action
][144]
[

### Prevents Misconfigurations and Policy Drift

Continuously monitor firewalls, cloud, SASE, and microsegmentation environments to ensure alignment
and enforcement of security policies, preventing lateral movement paths before attackers can exploit
them.

See it in action
][145]
[

### Simplifies and Optimizes Security Policy Management

Reduces policy complexity by analyzing and cleaning up redundant, risky, and outdated rules, while
automatically enforcing least-privilege access to strengthen your overall security posture.

See it in action
][146]
[

### Maintains Continuous Compliance and Audit Readiness

Reduces audit effort and minimizes regulatory risk by continuously assessing policies against
internal standards and external frameworks such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOX, DORA, and NIST.

See it in action
][147]

## A Control Plane for Your Entire Network Security Ecosystem

Tufin integrates seamlessly with the technologies powering your hybrid network—from firewalls to
cloud, SASE, microsegmentation, and beyond.

### Multi-Vendor Firewalls

Centralized visibility and unified policy enforcement across traditional and hybrid mesh
architectures, including Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, Check Point, Fortinet, and more.

The control plane streamlines management, eliminates configuration silos, and ensures consistent,
least-privilege policies across on-premises and cloud networks—helping security teams operate faster
and reduce risk at scale.

### Cloud Environments

Streamlines and automates security policy workflows across public and private cloud
platforms—including AWS, Azure, and GCP to ensure consistent enforcement, reduce risk, and
streamline operations.

The control plane delivers unified visibility across hybrid networks, automates cloud onboarding and
change workflows, and enforces least-privilege policies to prevent network exposure.

[Learn more][148]

### SASE & Edge Networks

Unifies and orchestrates security policies across edge networks by governing and managing
SASE-driven network policies, ensuring consistent, least-privilege access everywhere your remote
users are located.

The control plane provides visibility and control over Firewall-as-a-Service (FWaaS), Zero Trust
Network Access (ZTNA), and SD-WAN policies—ensuring users and workloads stay securely connected
across the network edge and cloud.

[Learn more][149]

### Network Device Topology

Delivers the most accurate network topology for complete visibility across routers, switches, and
connected devices to improve troubleshooting, planning, and operational efficiency.

The control plane automatically maps every network access path and security policy, giving teams a
continuously updated view of their network infrastructure and eliminating blind spots that may lead
to outages or security gaps.

### Microsegmentation

Centralizes visibility and policy management across microsegmentation technologies to enforce
granular, application-level segmentation at scale. Tufin aligns microsegmentation controls with
existing network security policy to eliminate gaps, reduce complexity, and prevent policy drift.

By unifying microsegmentation with traditional firewall and cloud policy management, the Tufin
Control Plane ensures consistent enforcement across hybrid environments. Organizations can isolate
critical assets, prevent lateral movement, and maintain continuous compliance with automated policy
validation and change governance.

[Learn more][150]

### Zero Trust

Operationalizes Zero Trust by enforcing least-privilege access across the entire network security
stack. Tufin ensures that every connection request is verified, authorized, and continuously
monitored through centralized policy orchestration and automated risk-aware change workflows.

By aligning identity-driven access controls with network and cloud security policy, the Tufin
Control Plane eliminates blind spots and ensures consistent enforcement across hybrid environments.
Security teams gain unified visibility, measurable risk reduction, and continuous compliance without
increasing operational overhead.

#### **MAKING THE INTERNET SAFER & MORE SECURE**

# **Advanced Domain & URL Intelligence, SaaS App Intelligence, Phishing & Threat Intelligence **

### **Powering the Market Leading SASE, XDR, ZTNA, Web Filtering, and Brand Safety Solutions**

## Power Your Security & Safety Applications with Industry-Leading Intelligence

zvelo uses proprietary AI-based web classification, threat detection, and curation technologies to
analyze traffic from over 1 billion users and endpoints. This data is enriched with intelligence
from OSINT and third-party feeds to deliver unparalleled visibility, coverage, and accuracy. The
result is comprehensive URL classifications and intelligence data spanning domains, full-path URLs,
SaaS applications, phishing threats, and other malicious activities — powering a wide range of
applications and solutions.

[Domain Intelligence & Web Classification]

#### **Domain Intelligence & Web Classification**

Optimize your solutions with the industry’s most accurate and comprehensive URL classification
database, delivering precise, real-time categorizations to protect users and enhance digital
experiences. Achieve unmatched performance for web filtering, parental controls, brand safety,
contextual targeting, and more.

[Explore zveloDB URL Database][53]
[zveloWSI Web Services Intelligence]

#### **SaaS App Intelligence**

Transform your approach to data security with advanced intelligence on SaaS Applications. Gain
crucial insights, data sensitivity risk, and categorizations to empower your customers to prevent
data leakage and exfiltration and fully control access to SaaS Applications.

[Explore SaaS App Intelligence][54]
[Phishing Detection for Blocking and Threat Research]

#### **Phishing Intelligence**

Strengthen your defenses with PhishBlocklist to protect against active and emerging phishing
threats. PhishBlocklist is enriched with additional metadata attributes like date detected, targeted
brand, and other crucial data points to maximize your protection while virtually eliminating false
positives.

[Explore Phishing Intelligence][55]
[Proactive Threat Detection]

#### **Malicious Threat Intelligence**

Unlock actionable threat intelligence with zvelo’s Malicious Detailed Detection Feed. Critical
metadata like detection dates, malware families, and Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) can enhance
your threat detection capabilities driving faster, more effective analysis and response.

[Explore Threat Intelligence][56]

#### **USE CASES AND APPLICATIONS POWERING INDUSTRY PARTNERS**

## Maximize Potential for Your Solutions with zvelo

zvelo has a broad portfolio of partner services that can be used for powering applications including
web filtering, SASE, DLP, ZTNA, browser security, brand safety and contextual targeting, as well as
enriching threat intelligence and analysis.
